decisions.why: Anaesthetic Packs, Assistants Packs, Basic Packs and Burns Packs are procedure packs, matching 'Procedure & cannulation packs'.
Aurula Speculums, ENT Hooks, ENT Probes and Flanges are ENT surgical instruments and consumables.
Chlorhexidine Wipes, Cleansing Foams and Pre-injection Swabs are antimicrobial wipes/skin cleansing products.
Maternity Absorbents and Spackman Cannula are obstetric/maternity products.
Size-ranged sharps containers directly match 'Sharps & clinical waste containers'.
Accessories for the same recycled sharps container ranges - sharps & clinical waste containers.
Dental Absorbents, Dental Procedure Packs and Dental Surgical Instruments are dental consumables.
Veterinary Bandages, Cotton Wool and Woundcare are veterinary wound-management consumables.
12L/25L/50L cardboard containers are clinical waste containers, matching 'Sharps & clinical waste containers'.
Size-ranged clinical waste containers match 'Sharps & clinical waste containers'.
Alcohol Wipes and Sprays and Universal Wipes and Sprays are cleaning chemicals & consumables.
Chemopure Gloves and Hush Plugz Ear Plugs are general PPE items.
Accessories for clinical waste containers, matching 'Sharps & clinical waste containers'.
